dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Princess is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Princess has been observed to be highly kennel reactive. Noted to pull hard towards the other dogs in the kennel room and, in one instance, almost redirected onto the handler and attempted to nip them. With handlers Princess is observed to have a loose body and will engage in pattern games. Medically, Princess is apparently healthy.

Princess arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner describes her as social and affectionate. While in care, Princess has been observed to be highly kennel reactive noted to pull hard towards the other dogs in the kennel room and in one instance, Princess nipped at the handler and almost redirected onto the handler. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only, single pet home.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.
dog.name: Princess
